title: Epoch
description: Temporal engine for Minecraft which allows you to craft powerful anomalies to pause the world, step through ticks, and manipulate the master clock
body: # Epoch ### 1. Time in a bottle A high-cost artifact that intercepts the master server clock, completely freezing the world while leaving the player unaffected. **Global Stasis:** `Right-Click` to completely freeze the server tick rate **Precision Stepping:** `Sneak + Right-Click` to manually advance the frozen timeline by exactly 1 tick for frame-by-frame debugging. ### 2. Stasis Core A temporal storage device designed for localized time manipulation and acceleration. ### 3. F3 Debug Screen Improved F3 Debug Screen with better font and transparent interface --- ## Crafting Recipes **Stasis Core** * 1x Nether Scrap * 1x Heavy Core * 3x Echo Shards * 4x Crying Obsidian **Time in a bottle** * 1x Glass Bottle * 1x Clock * 2x Amethyst Shards * 3x Echo Shards 💻 **Open source at:** https://github.com/ansh3108/Epoch ---
